A.name: Ground-truth provenance
A.details: Both diagnoses load dataset_root/sequence/groundtruth.txt separately from saved prediction and confidence files. The pinned metric constructs dataset GT regions from finite positive-size rectangles, and Special(0) for invalid annotation rows. No model-generated target is substituted. All 80 paired GT digest declarations agree. Raw dataset bytes and benchmark distribution authenticity were not independently re-read. VOT rectangle overlap is used; this is not certification of an installed official toolkit/version. Invalid annotation does not prove physical absence.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details: R divides selected overlap sum by dataset-valid GT count. P averages overlap over confidence-selected frames. Macro averages and harmonic F are conventional metric operations, with no model-output max/min/mean rescaling. Prediction scores supply threshold candidates; GT-based dataset-wide best-F selection chooses the report operating point. The E3/E4 thresholds differ, so filtering-loss change is not a controlled same-threshold comparison. All-box R retains the dataset GT denominator and is only an upper bound for confidence filtering of a fixed nonnegative-overlap trajectory.

C.name: Result existence, scope, hashes, checkpoint declarations and metrics
C.details: All corrected listed artifacts exist. Both captures contain 80 unique rows and 101956 frames; all CSV fields, aggregate values, ranked rows, segment counts and source fingerprints agree. E4 metrics.json P/R/F/threshold/scope match. The initially supplied metric path is absent; both actual alternate sources hash to the captured metric digest. Checkpoint identity is a consistent declaration, not a locally hashed checkpoint. Each 325-entry remote-input map is internally bound, not evidence that the 320 raw prediction/confidence/GT/image files were opened locally. The scoped capture lacks raw arrays, plan/cases/prediction receipt/checkpoint bytes and independently authenticated original tool events. The native receipt records exit 0 and session/chunk IDs, while historical runtime remains UNATTESTED here.

D.name: Active metric path
D.assurance: static call path and captured-result consistency
D.details: The analyzer imports the pinned metric, calls _load_rows and _vot_overlaps within its 80-case loop, computes metrics, asserts saved P/R/F agreement and emits the captured schema from main. The launcher decoded as data contains the exact 7016-byte local analyzer and runpy.run_path(..., run_name="__main__"). The inspected OPE runner explicitly calls evaluate_depthtrack_results and writes its returned values to metrics.json, with CLI dispatch to ope_analyze. _determine_thresholds and _vot_overlaps are called inside that evaluator. format_metrics is an unused serialization convenience in this path, not an unexecuted claimed metric. Static routing does not attest the historical process.

E.name: Bounded scope and interpretation
E.details: The defensible scope is two successive own-history CDTB trajectories, each with 80 sequences, 101956 frames and 91300 valid annotation frames. No independent seeds, same-state intervention, module/text attribution, recovery validation, bitwise hidden-state replay, VOT completion or full-nine acceptance is established. These limits are explicit in the source and comparison output. Factor4 geometry matches inspected source, but the reconstruction uses serialized previous boxes and a point-center test. Low-IoU frame occupancy, long-segment onset and first causal divergence remain distinct.

F.name: Evaluation type
F.assurance: classification of inspected source and recorded provenance; raw GT UNATTESTED
F.details: Dataset annotation rectangles are separately loaded and used for overlap and current-center diagnostics, so real_gt is the correct classification. This label does not independently authenticate raw GT bytes, benchmark implementation equivalence, actual runtime or causal performance gains.
